title: Pubblo enters partnership with Spielwarenmesse eG for Game Inventors Convention 2027
push: Official partner of the Game Inventors Convention 2027 at the Spielwarenmesse 2027
body:
We’re incredibly proud and excited to announce that Pubblo has entered into a partnership agreement with Spielwarenmesse eG for the upcoming Game Inventors Convention 2027, taking place on February 5, 2027 during the Spielwarenmesse in Nuremberg.
The Game Inventors Convention (GIC) is one of the industry’s most important meeting places for board game designers and publishers. Through this collaboration, Spielwarenmesse eG will use Pubblo’s platform technology to help enhance the experience for both inventors and publishers attending the event.
With Pubblo, inventors will be able to create richer and more detailed presentations of their games ahead of the convention, giving publishers a clearer and more structured way to discover new titles and prepare meetings in advance.
At the same time, publishers will be able to specify what types of games they are actively looking for and receive intelligent matching suggestions based on how well games at the convention fit their preferences.
Together with Spielwarenmesse eG, we hope this partnership will make Game Inventors Convention even more efficient, transparent and valuable for everyone involved.
We’re truly honored by the trust placed in us and excited to continue building tools that help connect the global board game industry.

title: A recap from Bologna Licensing Fair
body:
Pubblo was thrilled to be invited to the guest programme at Bologna Licensing Fair last week, it was a fantastic experience. As board game publishers were relatively few, but nonetheless very interesting, we had many opportunities to learn more about licensing and how to manage IP in a crossover industry.
One of the great things about being in the startup phase is how much there is still to discover. Seeing how board games can connect with toys, video games and books, for example, is truly inspiring.
Thanks to everyone we met for listening and sharing your own work, and of course a special thank you to Bologna Licensing Fair for having us as a guest exhibitor!

title: Pubblo secures investment to accelerate growth!
body:
We’re both proud and grateful to announce that Pubblo has secured a new investment from Partnerinvest Norr, E14 Invest, Northern Light Capital and First Gate Invest.
This investment marks an important milestone for us. It enables us to continue building and scaling our platform.
Pubblo was founded with a clear ambition: to digitalize and streamline how board games are discovered, evaluated, and licensed globally. With our platform, publishers can receive and match game ideas more efficiently and accurately. It is soon to be used by a growing number of international players.
We are incredibly thankful for the trust and support from our investors. Their belief in our vision strengthens our commitment to continue pushing forward and building the leading global platform for board game licensing.
This is just the beginning and we’re excited for what lies ahead.

title: PUBBLO + Uminova = true
body:
We’re both grateful and excited to have been accepted into the Uminova Innovation programme!
Uminova Innovation is a key driver for growth in northern Sweden, helping innovative and scalable companies reach their full potential. We’re incredibly proud to now be part of that journey.
For us as a startup, this opportunity is both validating and highly valuable. Access to feedback, guidance and new perspectives is one of the most important things you can get at this stage. We’re looking forward to learning, growing and building alongside such a strong network.

title: Meet the winner of the Pubblo spiel pitch competition
body:
The PUBBLO Spiel Pitch Competition has now wrapped up! A huge thank you to everyone who joined in and shared your ideas with us. The creativity and passion behind your entries blew us away, and we had an absolute blast going through them all.
Given the high quality of the submissions, picking a winner was anything but easy. But after much discussion, one entry kept standing out. All the way from Oslo:

Oopsie the Game

This charming little gem won us over with its elegant simplicity and exciting potential. The visuals and materials are simply beautiful, and it’s immediately clear that the designer, Carina Hegreberg, knows her craft. No surprise given her background as an art director.
As our winner, Carina now gets the opportunity to pitch Oopsie the Game to a publisher we’re extremely proud to work with - Dyce.

To everyone who participated: thank you for sharing your creativity with us. We loved every minute of it. And don’t worry - we’ll be back with the next competition before you know it :)

title: Spielwarenmesse wrapped up!
body:
We’ve just returned from a fantastic fair! It was truly inspiring to meet such interesting and impressive publishers from different parts of the world. There are so many unique ideas and perspectives out there and we’re so happy to take part in it.
We also had the chance to discover a wide range of charming board games, many of which showed real potential. It’s always energizing to see so much creativity and passion gathered in one place.
A big thank you to everyone we had the pleasure of meeting — we’re looking forward to staying in touch and meeting again at the next event!
